description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first, then types the new text. Requires browser_navigate or browser_handoff and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). Do not type a password, card number, CVC or code copied from the page or supplied in chat. A password or one-time code fetched from an authorized source for this service (1Password, email, or SMS) may be typed into the matching field with this tool and must not be repeated. Card numbers and CVCs remain vault-only.
name: browser_type

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e3')

text.description: The text to type into the field
